title: Citation with evidence-tier (engage-crucible)
description: Citation shape used in hypothesis briefs' priorEvidenceBase[] arrays. Carries an explicit evidenceTier so synthesis can weight citations by hierarchy. Empty citations arrays are permitted when --offline is set.

url.description: Optional URL — may be absent for paper citations without a stable URL.

evidenceTier.description: Hierarchy from strongest (systematic-review) to weakest (anecdote). Synthesis weights citations by tier.

fetchedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the citation was retrieved (web research only; absent in --offline mode).

excerpt.description: Short quoted or paraphrased extract supporting the claim.
